specs.title: An order placed through the API shows in the shopper's history

steps.title: Given a product is in stock
And I have placed an order for it
When I open my order history
Then I see my order with status "Authorized"

specs.title: The catalog shows products from the catalog service

steps.title: Then I see products from the catalog

specs.title: Each product shows its name, SKU and price

steps.title: Then each product shows its name, SKU and price

specs.title: Loading more shows the next page of the catalog

steps.title: When I load more products

specs.title: A new shopper's cart is empty

steps.title: When I view my cart
Then my cart is empty

specs.title: Adding a product puts it in my cart

steps.title: When I add it to my cart
Then the product shows it was added
When I view my cart
Then my cart has it with quantity 1

specs.title: Adding one more increases the quantity and total

steps.title: Given I have added it to my cart
When I view my cart
And I increase its quantity

specs.title: Removing the product empties my cart

steps.title: Given I have added it to my cart
When I view my cart
And I remove it from my cart
Then my cart is empty

specs.title: I cancel my authorized order

steps.title: When I cancel my order from my order history
Then I see my order with status "Cancelled"
And its stock is released

specs.title: I can't cancel once my order has shipped

steps.title: Given I open my order history
And meanwhile the operator picks, packs and dispatches my order
When I try to cancel it
Then I'm told it's past cancelling and pointed at returns
And my order is still "Confirmed"

specs.title: Cancelling while Pending stops fulfilment

steps.title: Given the operator opens order processing
And the operator has moved my order to "Pending"
When I cancel my order from my order history
Then the operator sees my order as "Cancelled"
And its stock is released

specs.title: An anonymous shopper places an order

steps.title: When I place my order paying with card "4242 4242 4242 4242"
Then my order is placed
And my payment is authorized
And the confirmation shows my shipping address and total
And its stock is reserved
And my order history eventually shows status "Authorized"

specs.title: Billing address different from shipping

steps.title: When I enter my shipping address

And I place my order

specs.title: A signed-in customer's order is saved to their account

steps.title: Given I am a registered customer
When I sign in
And I place my order paying with card "4242 4242 4242 4242"
Then my order is placed
And my order is saved to my account

suites.title: A declined card can be retried with another

specs.title: Example #1

steps.title: Given I am at checkout
When I place my order paying with card "4000 0000 0000 0002"
Then my payment is declined
And no order was created
When I pay with card "4242 4242 4242 4242"
And I place my order
Then my order is placed

suites.title: An item that sold out (<available> left) can be removed and the rest ordered

specs.title: An item that sold out (0 left) can be removed and the rest ordered

steps.title: Given I am at checkout with 2 of it and 1 of another product
When only 0 of it is left in stock
And I place my order paying with card "4242 4242 4242 4242"
Then it can't be reserved for insufficient stock
And no order was created
When I remove it from my cart and place my order again
Then my order is placed for the other product only

specs.title: An item that sold out (1 left) can be removed and the rest ordered

steps.title: Given I am at checkout with 2 of it and 1 of another product
When only 1 of it is left in stock
And I place my order paying with card "4242 4242 4242 4242"
Then it can't be reserved for insufficient stock
And no order was created
When I remove it from my cart and place my order again
Then my order is placed for the other product only

specs.title: A problem can't be reported without a reason

suites.title: A problem reported while <state> fails the dispatch

specs.title: A problem reported while Pending fails the dispatch

steps.title: Given the operator has moved my order to "Pending"
When the operator reports a problem: "Damaged in the warehouse"
Then my order shows as "Dispatch failed"
And it shows it wasn't dispatched because "Damaged in the warehouse"
And its stock is released
And my order history eventually shows status "Dispatch failed"

suites.title: Operator order console (US-24, US-25, US-22, US-20)

specs.title: The operator sees my order, its customer and its reserved stock

steps.title: When the operator opens the console
Then the console lists my order as "authorized" for my guest email
When the operator opens my order in the console
Then the console shows my order "authorized" with fulfilment "PENDING" and its stock "active"

specs.title: The operator cancels my order

steps.title: Given the operator opens my order in the console
And the console shows my order "authorized" with fulfilment "PENDING" and its stock "active"
When the operator cancels it from the console
Then the console shows my order "cancelled" with fulfilment "CANCELLED" and its stock "released"
And its stock is released
And my order history eventually shows status "Cancelled"

specs.title: The operator expires my payment authorization

steps.title: Given the operator opens my order in the console
And the console shows my order "authorized" with fulfilment "PENDING" and its stock "active"
When the operator expires its payment authorization
Then the console shows my order "cancelled" with fulfilment "CANCELLED" and its stock "released"
And its stock is released
And my order history eventually shows status "Cancelled"

specs.title: A shipped order can't be cancelled from the console

steps.title: Given the operator picks, packs and dispatches my order
And my order history eventually shows status "Confirmed"
When the operator opens my order in the console
Then the console offers no cancel or expiry, saying "Past cancelling — returns/refunds are out of scope (US-23)."

suites.title: Customer record and email history (US-27, and every customer email)

specs.title: A guest's record shows their order and its emails

steps.title: Given I have bought it with card "4242 4242 4242 4242"
And the operator picks, packs and dispatches my order
And my order history eventually shows status "Confirmed"
When the operator opens my customer record
Then it shows my order as "confirmed"
And it lists the emails "Your order has shipped", "Your payment was received" and "Your order is confirmed"

specs.title: A card declined at capture is emailed

steps.title: Given I have bought it with card "5555 5555 5555 4444"
And the operator picks, packs and dispatches my order
And my order history eventually shows status "Payment failed"
When the operator opens my customer record
Then it lists the emails "We couldn't take your payment" and "We couldn't process your payment"

specs.title: A failed dispatch is emailed

steps.title: Given I have bought it with card "4242 4242 4242 4242"
And the operator opens order processing
And the operator reports a problem: "Damaged in the warehouse"
And my order history eventually shows status "Dispatch failed"
When the operator opens my customer record
Then it lists the email "We couldn't ship your order"

specs.title: A registered customer's record shows their welcome email

steps.title: Given I am a registered customer
And I am at checkout
When I sign in
And I place my order paying with card "4242 4242 4242 4242"
And my order is placed
And the operator opens my customer record
Then it lists the email "Welcome to gshop"

specs.title: The cancellation email says why: I asked

steps.title: Given I have bought it with card "4242 4242 4242 4242"
And my order is cancelled by "me"
When the operator opens my customer record
Then the email "Your order was cancelled" says "was cancelled at your request."

specs.title: The cancellation email says why: support cancelled it

steps.title: Given I have bought it with card "4242 4242 4242 4242"
And my order is cancelled by "the operator"
When the operator opens my customer record
Then the email "Your order was cancelled" says "was cancelled by our support team."

specs.title: The cancellation email says why: the payment hold ran out

steps.title: Given I have bought it with card "4242 4242 4242 4242"
And my order is cancelled by "expiry"
When the operator opens my customer record
Then the email "Your order was cancelled" says "was cancelled because its payment authorization expired."

specs.title: The operator adds and removes one unit of stock

steps.title: When the operator finds the product in the catalogue
Then the catalogue shows its stock
When the operator adds one to its stock
Then the catalogue and inventory both show 1 more available
When the operator removes one from its stock
Then the catalogue and inventory both show 0 more available
